verdict.rationale: Railway's marketing claims users can 'run your application closer to where your users are' (railway-docs-7), implying multi-region/edge deployment, but there's no documentation of actual edge locations, CDN, or points-of-presence network. Community reports of a global outage taking down the 'ENTIRE service' due to total dependency on a single GCP region directly contradict the idea of a distributed edge network with redundancy. missing for 10: list of edge regions/PoPs, technical docs on edge routing/latency-based deployment, evidence the service is not single-region dependent.
